objective.name: sandbox.build.record
objective.description: Build a structured record payload from simple params.

#root.role: Turn simple string params into a structured record object reusable by DSL flows.

record._comment: The record object contains message, target_id, composed, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.

transformation_contract.morphing: Simple params become a structured record payload suitable for later DSL parameter construction.
invariants: message, target_id, and prefix are coerced to trimmed strings before record construction.
The output record always includes ctx_id and wrapper_name from the active wrapper runtime.
The composed field is deterministically built as prefix:message.
success: On success, sandbox.build.record returns a single record object ready for later DSL field extraction.
The record is self-contained and does not require additional wrapper state to interpret.
failure: sandbox.build.record has no contract-level validation failure for missing params because absent values are normalized to empty or default strings.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This capability is a pure payload shaper used by N7 aggregation scenarios.
The output is intended to be dereferenced by DSL runtime paths such as $alias.payload.record.message.
